author: neuropolimer
name: AccessRoleCheck
short: Synchronizes multiple independent access roles with their own key roles.
description: Automatically synchronizes multiple independent target roles. Each target role has its own configured set of key roles: if a member has at least one key for that target, the target role is granted; otherwise it is removed. Existing v1 single-role configuration is migrated automatically. Effective channel permissions and ownership are intentionally ignored.
install_msg: Loaded `accessrolecheck`. Existing v1 settings migrate automatically. Create another independent group with `[p]accessrole addcategory @TargetRole @KeyRole`, inspect everything with `[p]accessrole list`, and run `[p]accessrole sync` if needed.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store end-user data. It only stores guild configuration containing role IDs.
